article.title: New Engen公布內部AI工具Bakery，把投放數據接入創意簡報
article.summary: New Engen披露旗下創意團隊已使用Bakery，參考過往廣告表現來構思、寫簡報及起草腳本。
highlights: 團隊可搜尋過往表現較佳的創意概念。
從簡報生成選角需求仍屬計劃。
article.why: 媒體與創意團隊可先統一素材和投放數據的標籤，讓下一輪簡報有可追溯依據。
article.next_step: 挑一個產品，將歷來素材按受眾、訴求和版型標記，再試寫兩份不同方向的簡報。
article.detail: Bakery由New Engen旗下Donut Studios開發，已用於代理商內部製作。公司描述的流程是先找過往創意概念，再把投放表現帶進構思和簡報，最後在同一環境草擬腳本。公告未列明對外開放安排。品牌可先保存每個概念的投放條件，以免把不同受眾或版位的結果直接並列。
article.title_en: New Engen unveils internal AI tool Bakery to bring ad data into creative briefs
article.summary_en: New Engen says its creative team uses Bakery to bring past ad results into ideation, briefing and scripting.
highlights_en: Teams can search previously high-performing creative concepts.
Generating casting requests from briefs is still planned.
article.why_en: Media and creative teams can align asset and performance tags so the next brief has traceable evidence.
article.next_step_en: Choose one product, tag previous ads by audience, message and format, then draft two distinct briefs.
article.detail_en: Bakery was built within New Engen's Donut Studios and is used in its own production. The agency describes finding past concepts, bringing campaign performance into ideation and briefing, and drafting scripts in the same environment. External availability was not specified. Brands can record campaign conditions before comparing results across audiences or placements.
